pages.text: Build this at a crafting table. Place Blueprint Storage directly beside it, and load a populated blueprint.

pages.title: Make your first item
pages.text: $(li)Carry all required ingredients in your inventory.$(li)Right-click the Constructor.$(li)Hover over a result to check what is missing.$(li)Double-click its blueprint to craft.$(br2)The result goes into your inventory. Leave room so it does not drop at your feet. Manual construction needs no flux supply.
